data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Al means 'exalted' or 'noble'. In Christianity, it is a name derived from the Hebrew biblical figure El, the chief God of the ancient Canaanites, who was later absorbed into the Abrahamic God. This name is often used to signify kindness, faith, and loyalty. The name Al carries the meaning “Exalted, noble, kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Al usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
